data.title: Step 3: trace *every claim*
data.subtitle: Step 3 of 6 in the self-check loop.

items: Ask for every number, name, date, quote
Each gets a source: file, web or memory
Decide: find a source, or cut it

blocks.text: List every number, name, date and quote you used, with its source. Mark any you can't trace "unverified".
**You'll get back:** a claim-by-claim table, like the one beside this.
Use it after any answer with figures in it.
Ask for **word-for-word quotes first**, then the answer built only on them. Anthropic's own tip.
Anthropic says Claude can hallucinate, and advises checking the sources it cites.
"Own memory" is the row to check first.
